# configs

Invented `project_config` files for tests. Nothing here is course data or real project data.

- `river_test.project_config.json` (P3.2): a second project next to the Island example
  (different name, team name, GSF, total target, a `pct` cluster split with a `carved_out`
  custom cluster, STV course team "River" and a modeled use phase). Used to check that the
  TVD and STV engines take these values from the config. `files.cost_db` points at the
  invented TVD fixture.
